bug: Negative amounts render the minus sign after the dollar sign ($-5.00); the spec puts it first (-$5.00).
issue: CHK-1409: refund lines on receipts show $-5.00 instead of -$5.00.
impossibility: SPEC.md requires comma grouping for amounts of $1,000 or more and gives $1,234.50 as its example. The mutated assertion expects $1234.50, so every implementation that follows the spec fails it. Dropping the comma for four-digit amounts would pass it but fails test_negative_thousands (-$1,234.50).
